About the Token

Woldfish (WFISH) is a community token on BNB Smart Chain with a fixed supply of 1,000,000,000. Anyone can mint 10,000 WFISH free (once per wallet, gas only), or use the paid mint: 2,000,000 WFISH plus a Woldfish NFT and a 7-day daily bonus. WFISH powers the Woldfish Fishing Game — tap fish to earn WFISH (up to 10,000 per wallet per day) and withdraw automatically, with no manual payout queue. It also buys Woldfish NFTs in the game's shop, and it already trades on PancakeSwap. All core contracts are verified on Sourcify (Perfect Match), and the mint site supports 11 languages.

How It Works & Terms

Straightforward, no sweet promises.

  • The mint is free — you only pay gas You pay nothing for the tokens. The only cost is the BSC network gas fee (in BNB), paid directly to the network — usually very small. Make sure your wallet holds a little BNB for gas.

  • Once per wallet Each wallet address can only mint once (10,000 WFISH). This rule is enforced by the smart contract — a wallet that has already minted will be rejected if it tries again.

  • A PancakeSwap pool already exists WFISH can already be traded on PancakeSwap through its official pair below. The price follows the pool and can go up or down at any time — a free mint is not a guarantee of profit.

  • Never share your seed phrase This page never asks for your seed phrase, private key, or password. Anyone asking for them in Woldfish's name is a scammer.

This page is not a Telegram mini-app — it is the official Woldfish mint web page. Mint transactions happen directly between your wallet and the smart contract on BNB Smart Chain.

No visitor data is sent to a server. Mint status is read directly from the blockchain every time the page opens, and fishing-game records are stored only in your own browser (localStorage).
